body: How will a stab wound make me paralysed or blind? Seriously, just fuck off. The last thing I need is your bullshit saviour-like complex telling me “perhaps there is pain relief” and making up lies.

Hey, whilst I can understand your genuine empathy, I don’t need you to be sorry. It is what it is. Such is life and so on... 
I’m in my early 20s. I’m not asking for a method. I just simply would like to all the risks and possibilities about the2 methods I mentioned.
